headline: Rajratan Global Wire posts ₹370.83 cr revenue, EBITDA margin falls to 12.3%
hook: EBITDA margin shrinks, profit pressure rises
summary: Rajratan Global Wire reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹370.83 crore. The company's EBITDA margin declined to 12.3% year‑on‑year, indicating lower profitability. The slowdown reflects pressure on margins in the wire and cable sector amid rising input costs. Investors in the stock or sector may see earnings pressure and potential impact on share price.
why_it_matters: Margin dip may pressure stock price

headline: Rajratan Global Wire releases September quarter financial results
summary: Rajratan Global Wire Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides statutory data on the company's financial performance during the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can review these figures to assess revenue and profitability trends. Such disclosures help evaluate the operational health of the company.
why_it_matters: Check quarterly earnings for margin and revenue shifts.
